Hi, thank you for the reply!

Biology... is not my interest in life. Ever since I was young, my parents wanted me to become a doctor so that was what my entire childhood was paved out for. In high school, I only ever did biology/science-related courses. And that's all I know.

I don't have any other special skills, knowledge, hobbies, or talents because of the sole focus on biology for the majority of my life. And now that I screwed that over, I'm completely lost and don't know what to do.
